description:
Camtasia generates clear how-to videos from nothing more than a single screen capture. Transform one or more screenshots into a narrated instructional video in seconds. Final videos support learning outcomes by pairing scripted directions with animated cursor movements and other transitional features, including zoom and pan effects. 

With the support of Camtasia’s generative screencast, all you need is one screenshot and one prompt to create a training video. Explain a process, clarify a workflow, or create a software demo. No video editing or screen recording required.

defaultPrompt: Turn these screenshots into an onboarding video
